title: What the hell is this place??
content: I was having a good dream about my old dog that passed away last night when all of a sudden my subconscious decided to bring me here?? I've never been here in my life and it was frightening! I was at one of the doors and dropped my phone and wallet and screamed for help while water was running through the pipes. The only people who could hear me were other "contestants" of the pool area?? It almost felt like a competition and a crowd was watching. I had this intense feeling that the water would drown me so I literally forced myself to wake up irl. The frick is this place? Never been here ever in a dream or irl. Happened after a few months long break from seeing the Mall World in my dreams. Anyone else have something similar happen to them?
